timeline.summary: Foseco India Limited posted its investor presentation on June 28, 2026, for analyst/institutional investor meetings on June 29–30, 2026, via its website.
Foseco India Limited approved acquisition of Vesuvius India Limited's Mehsana crucibles business undertaking for ₹43.25 Cr via slump sale, to be completed by 31 December 2026.
Foseco India reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹231.41 Cr and PAT of ₹36.4 Cr, reflecting sequential improvement in operations.

Foseco India Limited’s **Mahendra Kumar Dutia** (Controller of Accounts & Company Secretary) announced analyst/institutional investor meetings from August 18–20, 2026, with presentations available online.
